places.name: Diocletian’s Palace (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: Diocletian’s Palace is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the best-preserved Roman architectural complexes in the world.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and hidden corners of the palace.

attribution.title: Croatia-01239 - The Peristil (9551533404)
attribution.author: Dennis G. Jarvis
attribution.description:
The Peristil is the rectangular space at the centre of Diocletian's Palace. On the left is the Cathedral of St Domnius and straight ahead is the Protiron intended to "frame" Emperor Diocletian as he emerged from his private apartments through the Vestibule ready to receive the adoring masses.
The opening in the lower centre is a stairway to the substructure (basement) of Diocletian's Palace.

places.name: Riva Promenade
places.ai_summary: Riva Promenade is a vibrant waterfront area in Split, perfect for strolling, dining, and enjoying the views of the Adriatic Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Lively atmosphere, especially in the evenings.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee or meal at one of the many cafes and restaurants along the promenade.

places.name: Cathedral of Saint Domnius
places.ai_summary: The Cathedral of Saint Domnius is a 4th-century Romanesque cathedral, known for its impressive bell tower and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Check for possible religious services or events.

places.place_tip: Climb the bell tower for a stunning view of the city and the sea.

places.name: Peristyle Square
places.ai_summary: Peristyle Square is a monumental courtyard from the Roman era, featuring impressive columns and the entrance to the Cathedral of Saint Domnius.

opening_hours.notes: A popular gathering spot with historical significance.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Vestibule and the Temple of Jupiter.

attribution.title: Split - Vestibulum (49018616268)
attribution.author: Fred Romero from Paris, France
attribution.description:
Grad - Ul. Iza Vestibula Diocletian's Palace, ancient palace built for the Roman emperor Diocletian at the turn of the fourth century AD, which today forms about half the old town of Split.

The Vestibule, is the first section of the imperial corridor in Diocletian's Palace that led from the Peristyle which was once the formal entrance to the imperial apartments of the Palace.

places.name: Marjan Hill Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Marjan Hill offers panoramic views of Split, the Adriatic Sea, and nearby islands, making it a favorite spot for nature lovers and photographers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear comfortable shoes for the hike.

attribution.title: Aerial view of Split in Croatia (48608603871)
attribution.author: dronepicr

places.name: Temple of Jupiter
places.ai_summary: The Temple of Jupiter is a well-preserved Roman temple, now a church, known for its beautiful architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Check for possible religious services or events.

places.place_tip: Observe the intricate details of the temple's architecture.

places.name: Old Town Split
places.ai_summary: Old Town Split is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its well-preserved Roman and medieval architecture, vibrant atmosphere, and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot to fully appreciate the architecture and atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Visit the local shops, cafes, and markets to experience the vibrant culture.

places.name: Bacvice Beach
places.ai_summary: Bacvice Beach is a popular sandy beach in Split, known for its shallow waters, vibrant atmosphere, and proximity to the city center.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguard service available during the day in the summer season.

places.place_tip: Try the local beach bars and restaurants for a taste of Dalmatian cuisine.

places.name: Split Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: The Split Archaeological Museum is the oldest museum in Croatia, featuring a vast collection of artifacts from the Roman, early Christian, and medieval periods.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Egyptian artifacts and the early Christian collection.
places.address: Museum of Croatian Archaeological Monuments, Split, Croatia

places.name: Gregory of Nin Statue
places.ai_summary: The Gregory of Nin Statue is a famous landmark in Split, depicting the medieval bishop Gregory of Nin, known for his role in the Christianization of Croatia.

opening_hours.notes: A popular spot for photos and resting.

places.place_tip: Rub the statue's toe for good luck, as per local tradition.

attribution.title: Gregory statue
attribution.author: Kommandant-Brot

places.name: Riva Harbor Cruise
places.ai_summary: A Riva Harbor Cruise offers a unique perspective of Split from the water, showcasing the city's waterfront, beaches, and the nearby islands.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for seasonal variations.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the beautiful scenery.

places.name: Green Market (Pazar)
places.ai_summary: The Green Market, also known as Pazar, is a bustling market in Split, offering a variety of fresh produce, local delicacies, and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for the freshest produce.

places.place_tip: Try the local olives, cheese, and cured meats.

places.name: Ivan Meštrović Gallery
places.ai_summary: The Ivan Meštrović Gallery is a museum dedicated to the works of the Croatian sculptor Ivan Meštrović, featuring a collection of his sculptures, drawings, and furniture.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful gardens surrounding the gallery.

places.name: Kasjuni Beach
places.ai_summary: Kasjuni Beach is a beautiful pebble beach located near the Marjan Hill, known for its clear waters and natural surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded than other beaches, offering a more relaxed atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snacks and drinks, as there are limited facilities.

places.name: Klis Fortress (Game of Thrones Site)
places.ai_summary: Klis Fortress is a historic stronghold offering breathtaking views and a connection to the popular Game of Thrones series.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during the winter season.

places.place_tip: Explore the fortress and enjoy the panoramic views of Split and the surrounding area.

attribution.title: Klis iz zraka
attribution.author: Općina Klis

places.name: Croatian Maritime Museum
places.ai_summary: The Croatian Maritime Museum is located in the historic city center of Split, showcasing the maritime heritage of Croatia through various exhibits and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby waterfront area and take a stroll along the Riva.

places.name: Fruit Square
places.ai_summary: Fruit Square is a charming square in the heart of Split, surrounded by historic buildings and lively cafes, and known for its vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: A great place to relax and people-watch.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby cafes for a taste of local pastries and coffee.

places.name: People’s Square (Pjaca)
places.ai_summary: People’s Square, also known as Pjaca, is a central square in Split, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and shops, and known for its vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: A popular gathering spot for locals and tourists alike.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique shops and local delicacies.

places.name: Split City Museum
places.ai_summary: The Split City Museum is located in the historic center of Split, showcasing the city's rich history and cultural heritage through various exhibits and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum's garden for a peaceful retreat.

places.name: Day Trip to Hvar Island
places.ai_summary: A day trip to Hvar Island offers a chance to explore the beautiful landscapes, historic sites, and vibrant nightlife of one of Croatia's most famous islands.

opening_hours.notes: Check the ferry schedule for seasonal variations.

places.place_tip: Visit the lavender fields and enjoy the local wine and cuisine.
